title: PiShip manifest (piship/v1)
description: piship.yaml for schema piship/v1. Editor hints only: piship validate is authoritative. Reference: https://github.com/tc3oliver/piship/blob/main/docs/manifest.md

app.description: Distribution identity: id, display name, command, and version.

version.description: Distribution semver, independent of PiShip and Pi versions.

banner.description: Optional banner text shown at startup.

theme.description: Built-in or declared custom theme name.

pi.description: Exact Pi version; must equal the version this PiShip pins. Leave out to follow the pin.

tools.description: Tool exposure, Codemode (off, on, only), and tool search (off, on).

cacheWarming.description: Prompt cache warming: mode (off, streaming, idle) and userOverride.

searchTools.description: Bundle pinned fd and rg: mode: bundled, optional fd and rg versions.

verifyAtLaunch.description: Verify the installed payload against the lock at every launch (default false).

mode.description: personal or managed; managed requires identity, credential, inference, and models.

resources.description: Instruction files, skill, extension, prompt, and theme roots grouped by trust class, and Pi packages.

instructions.description: Instruction Markdown files by trust class (company, user, certified).

skills.description: Skill directories by trust class (company, user, certified).

extensions.description: Pi extensions by trust class, plus builtin PiShip extensions.

prompts.description: Prompt roots by trust class (company, user, certified).

themes.description: Theme roots by trust class (company, user, certified).

packages.description: Pi packages (source npm, git, or local) with a trust class.

oidc.description: OIDC public client: issuer, clientId, flow, scopes, audience, redirectUri, httpTransport.

adapter.description: ./ path to an .mjs or .js IdentityProvider module.

credential.description: Where the inference credential comes from. Secrets are never declared here.

storage.description: provider: system (default) or file, and acknowledgePlaintext.

httpTransport.description: https forces https; http-allowed (default) admits plain HTTP to a private host.

default.description: Default model ID; must be in models.allowed.

catalog.description: Model metadata by ID: name, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, type, virtual, and more.

config.description: Pi settings the distribution enforces or defaults (model, theme, thinkingLevel).

userOverridable.description: Keys users may set; defaults to every key not enforced.

proxy.description: inheritEnvironment: honor HTTP(S)_PROXY and NO_PROXY (default true).

tls.description: additionalCA: absolute PEM bundle paths added to the trust roots.

privateOnly.description: Restrict requests to declared endpoint hosts plus allowHosts.

allowHosts.description: Exact hostnames or IP literals; no wildcards or suffix matches.

capabilities.description: Named capability contracts, each with enabled, provider, settings, and requirements.

permissions.description: Implemented by builtin/permissions; enabled by default.

workflow.description: Plan/Build mode; implemented by builtin/workflow; disabled by default.

default.description: Effect when no rule matches (default ask managed, allow personal).

adapter.description: ./ .mjs or .js module exporting team rules (narrowing only).

resourceTrust.description: allow or deny per resource trust class; project: policy, allow, or deny.

projectTrust.description: Project origin matchers and per-dimension effects.

enforced.description: Rules that nothing below can relax.

defaults.description: Distribution rules a personal user may relax.

userAuto.description: Managed only: allowed lets users switch on auto mode.

taskGrants.description: Caps on task grants: mode, maxTtlMinutes, actions, declared.

acknowledgeUnenforced.description: "<action>:<resource>" keys of rules no runtime seam enforces.

packs.description: Opt-in built-in rule packs, such as piship.routine.

mcp.description: MCP servers and where definitions may come from.

mode.description: off, allowlist (declared servers only), or explicit (personal only).

project.description: Whether project .mcp.json servers may be used in explicit mode.

user.description: Accepted; user-level MCP definitions are not loaded.

servers.description: Declared servers by ID (stdio or streamable-http).

sandbox.description: OS or remote sandbox for commands the agent runs.

required.description: true activates the sandbox and fails the launch when it cannot be enforced.

adapter.description: Backend setting for providers that use it.

endpoint.description: Remote provider endpoint; accepts runtime references.

router.description: Remote provider router; accepts runtime references.

namespace.description: Backend setting for providers that use it.

template.description: Backend setting for providers that use it.

workdir.description: Backend setting for providers that use it.

credential.description: Backend credential source for providers that use it.

httpTransport.description: https or http-allowed for sandbox.endpoint and sandbox.router.

workspace.description: remote: the remote sandbox directory is the workspace.

remote.description: Remote workspace seeding, pull, refresh, and cache settings.

environment.description: allow: variables passed into contained processes.

audit.description: Audit events and where they go.

enabled.description: Default true managed, false personal; needs at least one sink.

sinks.description: Sinks with id, type (file or http), url, and required.

capture.description: Opt-in content classes such as commandText.

updates.description: Update channel, source, rollback, and trust (required).

source.description: Update source URL; may be a runtime reference.

transport.description: https forces HTTPS-only; http-allowed admits plain HTTP to a private host.

rollback.description: Whether a failed update rolls back.

trust.description: Update trust bootstrap: root and channel signing keys.

sources.description: Origins the lock may download from.

vulnerabilities.description: npm audit settings, such as registry.

installScripts.description: Reviewed install scripts in Pi package closures.

data.description: Retention, purge, and export of local data.

temp.description: retention: parsed, not yet acted on.

purge.description: onLogout data classes and onUninstall (none or all).

export.description: allow, ask, or deny per export kind (public, local, support).
